title: Deep learning on post-thrombectomy CT predicts malignant cerebral edema
summary: In 271 stroke patients (168 training, 43 validation, 60 prospective internal test), a ResNeXt101 model using the hyperattenuated imaging marker reached AUC 0.897 in validation and 0.889 in the prospective test group. Model assistance raised radiologists' AUC by 0.137 for the junior and 0.096 for the senior reader.
ai_technology: ResNeXt101 deep learning on non-contrast CT hyperattenuated imaging marker

evidence.tested: Validation cohort and prospective internal test cohort of 60 patients, plus reader assistance comparison.
evidence.unknown: Single center; small test set; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning predicts malignant cerebral edema from post-thrombectomy CT.
